review.notes: UNSETTLED - see flag needs-escalation. The goat variant replaces the modern early return with a bare `Duel.GoatConfirm` call and does NOT return, so on a whiff (fewer than 2 eligible Spell/Trap cards in Deck) execution falls straight through into the monster selection and then `local sg=g:Select(tp,2,2,nil)` on a group of fewer than 2 cards. I cannot settle from the packet whether that is deliberate - the era activation allowance (B) would imply you activate, reveal, and proceed with what you have - or an upstream omission of `return`; a human should test the whiff path in EDOPro before this variant is shipped. Everything else is non-behavioural: CATEGORY_SET is dropped from the goat activation category (operation-info/AI hint metadata only - both scripts run the same `Duel.ChangePosition(tc,POS_FACEDOWN_DEFENSE)` with the EFFECT_LIGHT_OF_INTERVENTION branch), `0x11` == TYPE_MONSTER|TYPE_NORMAL, `RESET_EVENT+0x47c0000` == the spelled-out RESET_TOGRAVE|RESET_REMOVE|RESET_TEMP_REMOVE|RESET_TOHAND|RESET_TODECK|RESET_OVERLAY mask, and `Duel.GetTurnPlayer()==1-tp` == `Duel.IsTurnPlayer(1-tp)`. Chain starts at lineage v1 (DB1-EN087, 2004-10-12), which the goat cdb text matches exactly; v0 (PSV-033, 2002-10-20) predates the baseline. Lineage v1 -> v6 (SBCB-EN017, 2020-11-26) recorded as cosmetic: upstream implements no behavioural difference for "non-Monster Cards" -> "Spell/Trap Cards" (both use `c:IsSpellTrap()`), for "Special Summon them as Normal Monsters (ATK 0/DEF 0)" (both register the same EFFECT_CHANGE_TYPE/REMOVE_RACE/REMOVE_ATTRIBUTE/SET_BASE_ATTACK/SET_BASE_DEFENSE stack), for "cannot remain on the field except during this Battle Phase" (both register the same end-of-Battle-Phase `s.desop` destroy-then-send-to-grave), or for "in your Main Monster Zone" (both use `c:GetSequence()<5`, a post-Link rules distinction irrelevant to the era). Verification-half bounds: old attested through 2011-02-02, modern from 2019-04-03.

event.historical_text: Select 2 non-Monster Cards from your Deck and 1 of your Monster Cards on the field, then shuffle your Deck. Shuffle the 3 selected cards and Set them on the field in face-down Defense Position. The 2 cards selected from your Deck are treated as monsters (ATK 0/DEF 0) and are destroyed at the end of the Battle Phase. You can only use this effect during your opponent's Battle Phase.
event.summary: Period ruling package. Activation condition: the modern `s.target` requires `Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.spfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,2,nil,e,tp)` - two eligible Spell/Trap cards actually in the Deck - while the goat condition drops that clause entirely, so Magical Hats can be activated during the opponent's Battle Phase with fewer than two hats available. Failed-search verification: where the modern script bails out with `if #g<2 then return end`, the goat script substitutes `if #g<2 then Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK) end`, revealing the Deck. Only the verification half is dated by the shared search-verification chronology, so the change is recorded unresolved.
